title: Prevent Sales Order Agent from skipping emails moved into monitored folders
summary: The Sales Order Agent no longer advances the email sync timestamp after polling, allowing emails moved to monitored folders to be retrieved if they fall within the configured start date instead of being permanently skipped.
key_points: Removed automatic advancement of Earliest Sync At timestamp after email polling
Moved emails retain their original received timestamp and are no longer excluded from retrieval
Configured Start Date remains the lower bound for email retrieval
Previously processed emails are still excluded via Graph's Outlook categorization
Added regression tests for empty and under-full polling scenarios
quote: Stop advancing Earliest Sync At after email polling.
